name: Olaberria (Spain)
description: Quartered red and white above and white and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Olaberria (a crescent and stars on red and white above a tree on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Olaberria; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Olaberria arms — crescent and stars on red and white above a tree on yellow
